verbatim_quote.original: many OpenRay subscription proxies are duplicates by host/IP ... add a new argument ... when the unique-host/unique-IP option is active, parsing must never register a duplicate host or domain ... Output must report how many duplicates vs how many unique came out.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Many OpenRay subscription proxies are duplicates by host/IP. Add a new argument: when the unique-host/unique-IP option is active, parsing must never register a duplicate host or domain, and the output must report how many duplicates versus how many unique proxies came out.

extracted_decision.summary: Add a unique-host/unique-IP dedup argument (off by default): the parser never registers duplicate hosts, and each run reports duplicate versus unique counts.
extracted_decision.rationale: The OpenRay feed carries many same-host duplicates and unique IPs are what matter.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Distinct nodes sharing a host are dropped when the flag is on.
